liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (3 reviews): Clouds cleared during the opener, which reviewer felt the band had caused for the crowd; Reviewer suggests Vince should have sung it, given Garcia's lyric-memory struggles at this point in time [11][14][15]
- **Corrina** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Corrina the show's highlight, praising the sublime jam that emerges from it; Reviewer lists Corrina at about 20 minutes, leading into Drums, The Last Time, Days Between and Around and Around [8][14]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says Bob and Jerry deliver a master class on Walkin' Blues, and Jack-A-Roe rips [15]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer says Ramble On Rose alone justifies downloading the whole show [10]

## The recordings

- **gd94-07-27.shure-smith.vernon.8725.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darby.119473.Flac1648**: audience recording; 17 songs; 171 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer thinks this AKG 451 recording sounds slightly better than the other audience tapes [15]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120301.Flac1644**: audience recording; 17 songs; 164 min [3]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120300.Flac2448**: audience recording; 17 songs; 164 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer later played this show during a July 4, 1995 fireworks display, timing Bob's Corrina vocal with the fireworks [8]
- Reviewer says it rained and was cloudy all day, but the sun emerged as Here Comes Sunshine began [11]
- Reviewer got a miracle ticket from two teachers after set one began, then saw Jerry's limo pass while hitchhiking afterward [12]
- Reviewer says Jerry sounds his age for most of the show, apart from the Corrina jam [8]
- Reviewer found the band tight in the first set and even better in the second [12]
- Reviewer says by 1994 the band had synced up with Vince Welnick, and Jerry sounds healthy [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-07-27.shure-smith.vernon.8725.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Chase Smith; transferred by Mike Rodriguez and Matt Vernon; source: Audience: Shure BG-40's [1]. Also: Recorded by Chase Smith with Shure BG-40 microphones into a Sony D-7, then passed through an unknown step to CDR; Copy came via Mike Rodriguez and was seeded to etree by Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darby.119473.Flac1648**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Teac DA-P20 @ 16/48; Transfer… [2]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120301.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby (2nd Source); AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> AKGBP18s>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer… [3]
- **gd1994-07-27.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120300.Flac2448**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby (2nd Source); AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> AKGBP18s>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Reonegro Grateful Dead 7/27/1994 St. Louis Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_940727.html) [18]
